newsitem.title: USA: Semiconductor sees wafer reclaim revs up.
newsitem.headline: Semiconductor sees wafer reclaim revs up.

text.p: Semiconductor Packaging Materials Co Inc on Wednesday said that it sees improvement in the silicon wafer reclaim market in the U.S. and Europe and expect stronger revenue in the second half of 1997 over the first half of 1997.
Silicon wafer reclaim is when used silicon wafers -- used in the making of computer chips -- are cleaned and refurbished and sold to other chip companies for test purposes.

Earlier, the company said earnings per share for the second quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997, amounted to $0.14 and $0.22, respectively, as compared to $0.21 and $0.37, respectively, in the comparable 1996 periods.
